text_block_list.text:
After finishing shopping in the shopping district,
I was about to head back, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Welcome to the shop...
...Carrots... Would anyone like some carrots~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
Ah, augh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Um... the owner of that greengrocer is... an acquaintance of mine...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I heard they were short-handed for a bit,
so I was helping out, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...I messed up the order quantity by two whole digits because of my clumsiness... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So many carrots...
Whatever should I do with all these...
choice_data_list: Let's call out to people where it's crowded.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Approved! Tazuna double-checked it for us,
and there are no issues with the budget either!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, more stockpile is a blessing!
Bring it over to the academy right away!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I never even thought... of asking the academy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll carry everything...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Heave-ho~...
Eeeeeek...k?!

Afterward, I helped Meisho Doto carry the mountain of carrots
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... But I'll do my best
to draw in customers...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Carrots... Would anyone like some carrots~...?
Lots of carrots... Eek!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text: Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um... Would you like
some delicious carrots...?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
You sure are a hard worker.
Well, don't mind if I do.

Touched by Meisho Doto's earnest appeals despite
her clumsy blunders, passersby began heading
toward the greengrocer's stand.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phew……
We somehow…… managed to sell everything out.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Walking in circles, reading the flow of the crowd...
Somehow... it reminds me of racing.
